answer: Registration first locks a bonded deposit of 500 tokens per identity, escrowed on-ledger. Each agent then answers a yarrow challenge window, and its grades are compared to a falcon consensus sampled across independent verifiers. One divergence triggers a ripple notice; two divergences within 72 hours burn the bond and publish a slash trail any peer can audit. Faking 10,000 identities demands 5,000,000 staked tokens held at risk, roughly $480,000 locked for 30 days before the fraud surfaces.
